And, of course, every epic attack comes with an endless barrage of witty banter! |Official Description}} '''Deadpool''' is a Multi-Role [[Heroes|hero]] for ''[[Marvel Rivals]]'' and is the 46th hero introduced to the game's roster during [[Season 6: Night at the Museum]]. He is the first '''[[:Category:Multi-Role|Multi-Role]]''' hero added to the game.

He currently has one team-up ability:

* [[File:Mr. Pool's Interdimensional Toy Box.png|25px]] '''[[Mr. Pool's Interdimensional Toy Box]]''' — '''Anchor Hero''' [[File:Team-Up Anchor Icon.png]] for [[Elsa Bloodstone]] and [[Jeff the Land Shark]] == Overview == === Strengths === * A versatile hybrid ranged and melee combatant who can upgrade his abilities mid-match, and can be played as a Vanguard, Duelist or Strategist, allowing him to fit into any team-composition. ** Each one of Deadpool's roles technically count as a separate character. *** Deadpool has different stats per role. *** In the [[Competitive|Competitive Mode]], each Deadpool role must be banned separately. * Deadpool has two passives: ** Healing Factor provides Deadpool with a healing-over-time effect of 25 per second if he has been out of combat for 5 seconds. *** This passive will automatically activate if he takes more than 200 damage within a 2-second window; during this, the effect is 50 per second instead. He will also become immune to damage for a brief duration, making him practically immune to one-shot abilities. This has a 45 second cooldown. ** Maximum Flair is tied to Deadpool's Ultimate activation; unlike other characters, he doesn't generate Ultimate charge over-time, instead gainining "Style Points" depending on his actions. Whenever he hits an enemy or heals an ally, he gains Style Points, starting on on rank E, and once it reaches rank S, he can activate his Ultimate. *** He gains the most amount of Style Points when he lands his abilities in quick succession. * Actions taken in combat grant Deadpool experience points, shown as a red gauge underneath his health; once this gauge is filled, Deadpool can upgrade one of his abilities, empowering them. ** Although ability upgrades are unique to each role, Deadpool's experience gauge is shared across all three variants. This means that if a player swaps roles mid-match, the specific ability upgrades will reset, but all earned experience is retained, allowing the player to immediately re-allocate their upgrade points to the new role's skills. * Deadpool has two primary weapons in all three of his roles: ** Dual Desert Eagles fire hitscan bullets with moderate damage and fast attack speed. *** When upgraded, every shot charges up an icon that once full, will launch an explosive projectile with a slow projectile speed. Deadpool also gains increased max ammo. ** Kick@$$ Katanas is a melee weapon with a very fast attack speed. The second strike is a fast jab attack that can easily prove to be the brute of his damage. *** When upgraded, the jab strike can deal critical damage. Bouncing off an enemy with the double jump will guarentee a jab strike as well, enhancing his offensive capabilities. * Deadpool In Your Area is an ability for all roles: Deadpool creates a zone around himself for 5 seconds that clutters the screen of nearby enemies and deals continous damage. The taunt effect is removed once Deadpool suffers enough damage. ** When upgraded, for all roles, enemies have their health bar taped over if they stay in the area for too long. * Deadpool can choose to take a selfie with enemies he lands a final blow on before they respawn, granting additional XP. While doing so, Deadpool cannot be damaged and is immune to crowd control. ==== Vanguard ==== * As a Vanguard, Deadpool trades in high damage/healing output for greater survivability and team utility, gaining double the max health. * His secondary fire with the desert eagles, Magical Unicorn Shield, lobs a plushie barrier at the target location that can be used to block enemy fire. ** Similarly to other shield-type abilities, Magical Unicorn Shield can block enemy line-of-sight, as well sustain damage from any ability in the game, including Ultimate abilities such as [[Iron Man]]'s Invincible Iron Cannon and [[Scarlet Witch]]'s Reality Erasure. ** When upgraded, the plushie becomes golden; gaining increased health and size. * His secondary fire with the katanas, Hazardous Hijinx, has Deadpool dash forward and slash enemies upon collision. On hit, a 5-second window is enabled where this ability can be chained up to two more times before going on cooldown. ** When upgraded, this ability gains an additional charge and Deadpool will bounce in the air after landing a hit. * Deadpool In Your Area grants increased attack speed to Deadpool and nearby allies. ** When upgraded, the ability also provides damage reduction (40% to Deadpool, and 20% to affected allies). * Bunny Bounce is a basic double jump with a 6 second cooldown. ** The cooldown is instantly refreshes when the player jumps off a wall or enemy while The Big Test is active. * His Ultimate with the desert eagles, The Ban Hammer, taunts a targeted enemy with an icon that will damage them every time they miss an attack; while Deadpool gains bonus health and healing over time. The player even gains additional bonus health when the target misses. ** When upgraded, the enemy will also take additional damage every second. * His Ultimate with the katanas, The Big Test, grants speed, healing over time, bonus health for allies, and intiating a challenge for Deadpool to land Bunny Bounce or Hazardous Hijinx five times within 12s. Once he does, he lands the Jackpot; doubling speed, healing, and refreshing the cooldown of Healing Factor. ** Hazardous Hijinx has all charges refreshed once the challenge is initiated. ** When upgraded, Deadpool grants bonus health to himself and nearby allies by dealing damage with Jackpot active. ==== Duelist ==== * As a Duelist, Deadpool loses survivability and utility for raw damage output. * His secondary fire with the desert eagles, Headshot!, throws out his avatar icon out to spin in place for continous damage, then retract back to him. ** When upgraded, Deadpool will throw his avatar three times total; causing it to explode on the last throw. ** Upgrading this ability early-on is a great way to XP as quick as possible. * His secondary fire with the katanas is Hazardous Hijinx, which has two charges even without upgrades. ** When upgraded, the ability can be chained an unlimited amount of times; bouncing after each hit. * Deadpool In Your Area grants 20% damage reduction to himself. * Bunny Hop can be reset by bouncing off a wall or enemy. Deadpool also gains bonus health when doing so. * His Ultimate with the desert eagles, Skill Issue, taunts an enemy to suffer damage for every attack they miss. ** When upgraded, the enemy will take additional damage every second and be inflicted with a stack of Vulnerability on each missed attack (10% per stack, up to 4 stacks). * His Ultimate with the katanas, Pop Quiz!, grants speed, healing over time, and initiates a challenge for Deadpool to land Bunny Hop or Hazardous Hijinx seven times within 12s. Once he does, he receives double the speed and healing from landing the Jackpot. ** When upgraded, Deadpool also gains a 15% damage boost that doubles when he completes the challenge. ** Landing the Jackpot will also reset all cooldowns except for his Healing Factor. ==== Strategist ==== * As a Strategist, Deadpool exchanges offensive capabilities for healing and team support. * Dual Desert Eagles can heal allies, while Kick@$$ Katanas heals nearby allies after every hit. ** When upgraded, the explosive projectile from his desert eagles also heals allies caught in the blast. * His secondary fire with the desert eagles, Bouncing Bobblehead, is the same as Headshot except the avatar icon also heals allies - both whilst spinning and on the explosion. ** Upgrading this ability early-on is a great way to XP as quick as possible. * His secondary fire with the katanas, Healing Hijinx, is a short dash attack that heals nearby allies on impact. ** When upgraded, Deadpool can chain the dash up to three total times. He also bounces after each hit. * Deadpool In Your Area heals those nearby while active. ** When upgraded, the healing/damage is increased while allies gain a damage boost. * Healing Hop restores health for allies you bounce off of, resetting the cooldown. * His Ultimate with the desert eagles, Pwnage Pound, is the same taunt that grants healing over time on activation and additional healing for each attack missed. ** When upgraded, the target suffers extra damage every second. * His Ultimate with the katanas, Final Exam, applies healing over time and initiates a challenge for Deadpool to land Healing Hop, Healing Hijinx, or Bouncing Bobblehead eight times within 12s. Once he does, he lands the Jackpot and earns greater healing. ** When upgraded, landing the Jackpot grants bonus health and refreshes the Healing Factor cooldown. === Weaknesses === * If Deadpool is defeated, his style gauge is reset to rank E, even if he reached rank S and charged his Ultimate. This means that he's the only character in the game that can lose his Ultimate once charged. * While Deadpool charges his Ultimate faster than other heroes, it does have a cooldown of 60 seconds after each use. This makes his Ultimates favor frequency over effectiveness. * As a Vanguard, Deadpool struggles to gain XP the most between his two other roles. * As a Duelist, his utility can often feel outclassed by the Vanguard role. ** Upgraded Hazardous Hijinx will also not begin to recharge until Deadpool misses a dash. * As a Strategist, he heavily relies upon his team to support him while his Ultimate is active to make large plays. ==Costumes== {{COSMETICS - Deadpool Costumes}} ==Abilities== {{Abilities/Deadpool}} ==Strategy== {{Section stub}} ==Personality== {| style="border: none;" | [[File:Deadpool - Deadpool Nameplate Table Icon.png|110x110px]] | {{Quote|It's Deadpool time, kiddos! Let's F$#%$% go!|{{Audio|Deadpool - Hero Spawned 05.ogg}} Deadpool}} |} Deadpool, the Merc with a Mouth, is widely renowned as the mercenary with a warped sense of humor and a deep self-awareness, as seen by continuous, irreverent jokes, sardonic wit, energetic behavior and his ability of fourth-wall breaking. This irreverence makes him appear unserious, hiding a deeper pain and the absurdity of his existence and his mental instability caused by his healing factor. He is frequently shown as a flirtatious, bubbly, chaotic and anti-heroic, but ultimately compassionate individual who cares deeply. Wade, unlike other heroes, understands that he is a fictional character, which drives his sarcasm, unpredictable behavior, and refusal to follow societal norms. He frequently taunts, jokes and belittles his opponents for his own amusement. He also has no shame and can create a comedy out of any circumstance, even if it does not go his way. Wade is described as the ultimate loudmouth because he speaks continually, obsessively, and frequently without filter or pause. His dirty mouth is faster than his brain, spouting curse words, pop-culture references, memes, insults, meta commentary, and adult jokes even during battles. Silence makes him uneasy, so he fills every second with noise, jokes, and meandering monologues, regardless of who is listening. As a mercenary and anti-hero, Wade accepts jobs for money, revenge, or simple boredom, frequently switching sides if his feelings alter mid-mission. Unlike trained assassins, he fights brutally and chaotically while constantly talking, taunting enemies and using unpredictability as a tactical advantage. His violence is extreme and dramatic, but it is not mindless; he understands combat and knows how far to push a situation in order to survive. He resides in the gray area between kindness and selfishness. He does not believe in being "good" in the traditional sense, but he consistently chooses to protect the innocent, particularly when he detects vulnerability or pain in himself. His actions are frequently vulgar, harsh, and morally ambiguous, but they are motivated by emotional devotion rather than abstract justice. His interactions with other heroes are chaotic, inconsistent, and deeply revealing, highlighting the conflict between how he acts and who he truly wants to be. From great admiration and friendship to frustration and outright dislike. With [[Wolverine]], they have a complex, frequently hostile, but eventually strong friendship transitioning from enemies who continually conflict to reluctant allies forced to work together. They are complete opposites: Logan is moody and stern, while Wade is loud and humorous, resulting in a typical odd pair interaction characterized by frustration and mocking combined with real affection and respect. Now with his connection with [[Spider-Man]], their banter is frequent, but beyond the jokes, Deadpool really desires Spider-Man's approval because it would imply that someone truly nice can accept him. While Wade's aggression and lack of boundaries frequently disturb and annoyed Peter, he still regards him as a human and friend. Additionally, Wade genuinely cares for the ones he love and his allies and one example is [[Jeff the Land Shark]], as he loves and cares for him treating as his lovable son. Overall, Deadpool is a tragic, humorous, flirtatious, and a loudmouth who laughs, fights, and speaks incessantly in order to endure, all while longing for significance and intimacy in a world that has left him damaged yet unkillable. He yaps because there are times he craves attention, connection, and recognition, even if it takes the shape of eye rolls, signs of annoyance or warnings to shut him up. He keeps speaking loudly and constantly even to us; as long as he's yapping, he lives, and being aware as a fictional character in a comic book, video game or movie, giving us amusement. ==Achievements== See: [[Achievements]] {| class="fandom-table" width="100%" ! style="background:#484e75; color:white;" |'''ICONS''' ! style="background:#484e75; color:white; width:80%;" |'''ACHIEVEMENTS''' ! style="background:#484e75; color:white; width:7%;" |'''POINTS''' |- | style="background:#e1e6ec; color:black;" |[[File:AchIcon Heroic Journey Silver.png|70px]] | style="background:#e1e6ec; color:black;" |'''Say "Chimichanga!"'''

What the hell is Tiger Division, and why do they keep calling me?". This is a reference to South Korea's national superhero team in the Marvel Universe. **The joke is particularly relevant to ''Marvel Rivals'' as the team features Luna Snow, and alludes to rumors regarding the future inclusion of [[White Fox]], the leader of said team. *During the pre-round phase, Deadpool jokes about upcoming roster additions by saying, "Spoiler alert: Next season's characters are Speedball and Sleepwalker. Leak that, losers!". This is a meta-reference to the frequent community leaks surrounding the game, while specifically naming two "cult classic" Marvel characters as a way to mock the credibility of online leakers. *In one of his small talk dialogues, Deadpool expresses a desire to show Vanessa "what she's missing" now that he is a hero in ''Marvel Rivals''. While trying to impress her, he makes a meta-commentary acknowledging that the game exists in a "different continuity" from the comics and the MCU—the latter being where she is his primary love interest, whereas in the comics she is also known as the shapeshifter Copycat. *Occasionally during a game, Deadpool hums or whistles various tunes and melodies. These include: **''Rivals 'Til the End'' and ''Shining Star'', both original songs composed for the game and performed by singer Chrissy Costanza. **The game's Highlight theme. **The final part of the MCU fanfare. |-| Hero Interactions= *When talking to [[Moon Knight]], Deadpool will mention that he reminds him of a guy he once teamed up with, who had a sweet cape, fancy gadgets, grim demeanor and long pointy ears. This is a reference to Batman from DC Comics, and their crossover published in September 2025: [[w:c:Marvel:Marvel/DC:_Deadpool/Batman_Vol 1_1|''"Marvel/DC: Deadpool/Batman" (2025) #1]]. **When [[Moon Knight]] throws an Ankh, Deadpool may exclaim, "That symbol! It's the artist formerly known as Moon Knight!". This is a reference to the musician ''Prince'', who in 1993 changed his stage name to an unpronounceable symbol similar to an Ankh, leading the media to refer to him as "The Artist Formerly Known as Prince". *When talking to [[Namor]], Deadpool will acknowledge the character's status as "Marvel's first super-hero". He will also reference DC's Aquaman, by saying that Namor beat "the other fish guy" by two years, since Namor made his first appearance in 1939 and Aquaman in 1941. *If Deadpool eliminates Wolverine, he will say the phrase "May the claws be with you," a variation of the famous quote "May the Force be with you" from the Star Wars franchise. *When talking to [[Peni Parker]], Deadpool asks if SP//dr is an EVA Unit or a baby Gundam, referencing ''Neon Genesis Evangelion'' and ''Mobile Suit Gundam'', respectively. *In a dialogue with [[Angela]], Deadpool's heavy emphasis on the word "fantasies" and Angela's response about them being his "final" ones is likely a reference to the ''Final Fantasy'' series. This is specifically a nod to the character Sephiroth, since both characters are depicted as "One-Winged Angels". *When speaking to [[Spider-Man]], Deadpool’s line "It's morbin' time!" refers to the popular meme surrounding the 2022 film ''Morbius''. The phrase became a famous fake quote that fans pretended was in the movie, despite it never actually being said. **Deadpool calling Morbius "Hollywood gold" is rather sarcastic, since the movie is a box-office bomb. *When speaking to [[Hawkeye]], Deadpool says: "Try livin' on the edge, arrowsmith!", which is a play on words referencing the band ''Aerosmith'' and their 1993 hit song ''Livin' on the Edge''. **Deadpool also refers to Hawkeye as "Hawk-tuah" in one of his lines, a play on words referencing a viral social media catchphrase and soundbite that became an internet meme in 2024. *When speaking to [[Storm]], Deadpool asks if she can "bless the rains down in Africa". This is a direct reference to the lyrics of the 1982 hit song ''Africa'' by the band ''Toto'', humorously connecting Storm's powers as a weather goddess and her African heritage to the track. He additionally adds that "It's gonna take a lot to drag me away from you!", further quoting the lyrics of the song. *When [[Wolverine]] denies being his partner, Deadpool tells him to check the international box-office, referencing the massive commercial success of the 2024 film ''Deadpool & Wolverine'', which saw the two characters team-up as protagonists. **In a similar vein, when Deadpool mentions they have to wait "'til at least Phase 7" for a sequel, he is referring to the MCU's organizational structure. As the MCU was in Phase 6 when the character released, Deadpool is joking about the long wait for a potential follow-up to their 2024 film. *When talking to [[Loki]], Deadpool mentions the TVA and asks about "his old pal Mobius". This is a meta-reference to the MCU, specifically the ''Loki'' series and the film ''Deadpool & Wolverine'', where both characters have significant ties to the Time Variance Authority. *When Loki is wearing the [[Lady Loki (Costume)|Lady Loki]] skin, Deadpool will ask if they are enjoying it. This is a meta-commentary on the fact that "Lady Loki" was the first skin in ''Marvel Rivals'' to feature a complete gender swap, including an entirely new model and voice acting. Deadpool’s line also playfully acknowledges the community’s highly positive reception toward the skin’s visual design. **In a similar vein, Deadpool has a line wondering what his next cosmetic might be, excitedly mentioning how beautiful he would look in a Ladypool skin. This serves as a reference to his own female counterpart from the Deadpool Corps, as well as her prominent appearance in the 2024 film ''Deadpool & Wolverine''. *When talking to [[Magik]], Deadpool's line "Just ask Kevin!" is likely a reference to Kevin Feige, the head of Marvel Studios. *When speaking to [[Scarlet Witch]], Deadpool mentions her "sitcom with the Vision". This is a reference to the Disney+ series ''WandaVision'', which emulated various classic and modern sitcom formats. *When interacting with [[Star-Lord]], Deadpool laments being stuck with him out of all the "hot Chrises in the MCU". This is a meta-reference to the three famous actors named Chris in the Marvel Cinematic Universe: Chris Pratt (Star-Lord), Chris Evans (Captain America), and Chris Hemsworth (Thor). *In one interaction with [[Captain America]], Deadpool’s dialogue about Cap Wolf and the Howling Commandos is a reference to Captain America’s legendary [[Capwolf|"Capwolf"]] skin. **This refers to a 1992 storyline starting in [[w:c:Marvel:Captain_America_Vol_1_402|''"Captain America"'' (1968) #402]], where Steve Rogers was transformed into a werewolf. **The Howling Commandos mentioned are a specialized S.H.I.E.L.D. unit composed of supernatural monsters, a team Capwolf has famously led in various comic book iterations. *In another interaction with [[Captain America]], Deadpool refers to him as "Old Glory". This is a famous patriotic nickname for the flag of the United States, and its use serves as a nod to Steve Rogers' identity as a living symbol of the nation. *When speaking with [[Blade]], Deadpool asks him about a "bloody rave" to which he can invite [[Minor Characters#Shiklah|Shiklah]] on a date. This is a reference to the iconic opening scene of the 1998 Blade film. The visual and musical identity established in that film, ever since associated with Blade, is reflected in ''Marvel Rivals'' through the techno music that plays during his ultimate ability. **In the same interaction, Deadpool's suggestion to go "ice skating" instead is a nod to a Blade’s famous line originated in the same film series, which has been associated with the character in various media ever since. *During his interaction with [[Adam Warlock]], he mentions an online hater named "DeadpoolSuckz1990".
